notes.title: Monster REMASTER Update!
notes.content:
DEAD SECRET CIRCLE just got a [b]Mega Remaster Update[/b]. We spent the last two years going over the game with a fine tooth comb to make it the best it can be. Included in this update:
[list]
[*]Completely reworked visuals for the entire game. New shaders, new lighting, new effects, new sequences.
[*]Key scenes and story beats updated and improved based on player feedback.
[*]Completely new character rendering system with shadows, normal maps, eye glints, and more
[*]Huge number of bug fixes and polish items.
[/list]
Check out some of the new shots below. If you haven’t checked out DEAD SECRET CIRCLE at all or it’s been some time, now is a stellar time. And right in time for Halloween!
